name: Nihongo Master v1.3.2 - Global Text Boundary Audit & Score Telemetry Overflow Fix
changelog: v1.3.2: Comprehensive text boundary audit across every UI container in the game. Fixed tactical score telemetry box where environmental notes were cut off by the right border (Stage 1 Broad Highway, Stage 8 Sakura Boulevard, and Stage 11 Secret Stage). Streamlined stage telemetry notes and added auto-scaling and ellipsis boundary guards. Refined distance card title font, Stage 11 chamber subtitle, and Stage 8 left panel header with generous lateral margins.
